scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
Hi there.
I don't know if I can be
of any assistance, but I
am trying to help older veterans
by exchaning the cards that
they are no longer using.
Ask for more information!
I don't have any cards right now.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
I am giving 1 point for each card that you bring me.
The points can be used to exchange for items that I have.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
For ^CC0000100 points^000000: ^0000CC1 Old Card Album^000000.
For ^CC000050 points^000000: ^0000CC20 Yggdrasil Berry^000000.
For ^CC000020 points^000000: ^0000CC10 Blue Potion^000000.
For ^CC00001 point^000000: ^0000CC4 Honey^000000.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: Well, remember this offer!

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
Welcome back!
I see you already have some
trading points. Actually, you currently have ^00cc00{0}^000000.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
Would you like to exchange these
points now, or you would like to exchange more cards?
I would like to exchange cards.
Can I exchange the points?

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: Please tell me what card you want to exchange.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: You don't have any ^0055FF{0}^000000 with you!

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
You've got ^0055FF{0}^000000.
 
Would you like to exchange 1 point for each of them?

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: Please, come back here if you want to exchange a monster card.
Yes, please!
No, thank you.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: Alright, you have received ^CC0000{0}^000000 points.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: Okay, let me know if I can help you with something else.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: These are the items that I have.
1 Old Card Album - 50 Points
20 Yggdrasil Berry - 50 Points
10 Blue Potion - 20 Points
4 Honey - 1 Point
^777777Nerver mind.^000000

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
Great, I wish you the best
of luck with this album. I have a
very good feeling about this one!

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
Oh, you must like adventures.
Here you go, just what you need!

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
Blue Potions? Are you sure?
If that's what you want, here they are!

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text:
It took many bees
to make all of this.
Make good use of it.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: Alright, come back when you have more points.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: Sorry, but you don't have enough points.

scripts.speaker: Putty
scripts.text: You have 0 points. You need at least 1 point to exchange.
